2610.13416.title: Web$hell: A Unified Interface for Agentic Web Access
2610.13416.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are becoming direct users of the open web. As they take on increasingly complex and information-intensive tasks, effective web access is becoming a core capability for agentic problem solving. Existing approaches have advanced agentic web access through different access models, including search-augmented agents, browser-based agents, and, more recently, filesystem-based agents. Nevertheless, as users expect agents to complete long-horizon, end-to-end tasks, they increasingly need to conduct broad information gathering, perform browser actions, and revisit acquired evidence within a single trajectory. Yet our preliminary analyses reveal that existing access models struggle to meet these demands. They primarily support either information gathering or browser interaction, while combining their capabilities can involve substantial costs or performance trade-offs. To this end, we present Web\$hell, an interface that unifies web access under a single access model. Using a common schema defined by WebContract, WebCompiler compiles live webpages into addressable information and action objects. These objects are maintained in WebCache and handled through a shared set of operations, providing agents with consistent, operable, and persistent web access. Through extensive experiments across web search, web navigation, and deep research benchmarks, we show that Web\$hell achieves strong task performance at lower cost. Our results further indicate the importance of interface design for effective web access, with Web\$hell opening new possibilities for more capable and efficient LLM agents on the web.
2610.13416.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理正在成為開放網絡的直接使用者。隨著它們承擔越來越複雜且信息密集的任務，有效的網絡訪問正成為代理問題解決的核心能力。現有的方法通過不同的訪問模型推進了代理的網絡訪問，包括搜索增強代理、基於瀏覽器的代理以及最近的基於文件系統的代理。然而，隨著用戶期望代理完成長期、端到端的任務，它們越來越需要在單一軌跡中進行廣泛的信息收集、執行瀏覽器操作並重新訪問獲得的證據。然而，我們的初步分析顯示，現有的訪問模型難以滿足這些需求。它們主要支持信息收集或瀏覽器互動，而結合它們的能力可能涉及巨大的成本或性能權衡。為此，我們提出了Web\$hell，一個在單一訪問模型下統一網絡訪問的界面。使用WebContract定義的通用架構，WebCompiler將實時網頁編譯為可尋址的信息和操作對象。這些對象保存在WebCache中，並通過一組共享的操作進行處理，為代理提供一致、可操作和持久的網絡訪問。通過在網絡搜索、網絡導航和深度研究基準上的廣泛實驗，我們顯示Web\$hell以較低的成本實現了強大的任務性能。我們的結果進一步表明，界面設計對於有效的網絡訪問的重要性，Web\$hell為更有能力和高效的LLM代理在網絡上開啟了新的可能性。
